description: Discrepancy in oxycodone-acetaminophen dosing frequency between pre-admission and discharge medication lists without explanation.
evidence_in_history: Oxycodone-acetaminophen prescribed as 1 tablet every 6 hours as needed for pain (prior to admission and outpatient records).
evidence_in_summary: Discharge medications list oxycodone-acetaminophen as 1 tablet every 8 hours as needed for pain, but the discharge summary does not clarify the rationale for this change.
suggested_correction: Document the reason and details for adjustment in oxycodone-acetaminophen dosing frequency in the discharge summary and ensure clear instructions in discharge medications.

description: DXA scan for bone density screening recommended multiple times but no documentation if ordered or scheduled during hospitalization or at discharge.
evidence_in_history: Office visit note on 2024-08-20 by PCP recommends DXA scan for bone density screening (due).
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary mentions DXA scan recommended but scheduling to be arranged by PCP; no confirmation or order documented.
suggested_correction: Include in the discharge instructions whether the DXA scan was ordered or provide clear referral/order instructions to ensure timely bone health monitoring.

description: Pain management plan during hospitalization includes adjustment of oxycodone-acetaminophen dosing frequency, but exact inpatient pain management regimen changes were not specified in the discharge instructions.
evidence_in_history: Outpatient notes indicated weaning oxycodone-acetaminophen and encouraging acetaminophen alone for mild pain.
evidence_in_summary: Summary states dosing frequency was adjusted during hospitalization but lacks specific details and recommendations for outpatient management.
suggested_correction: Document detailed pain management plan including any changes made during hospitalization and clear instructions for outpatient pain control on discharge.
